question:
Consider the fusion reaction:</br>
$$^{2}\text{H}+^{3}\text{H}\rightarrow {}^{4}\text{He}+n+Q$$</br>

Atomic masses are:</br>
$$m(^{2}\text{H})=2.014102\,u,\; m(^{3}\text{H})=3.016049\,u,\; m(^{4}\text{He})=4.002603\,u,\; m_n=1.008665\,u$$</br>
Take $1u\,c^2=931.5\,\text{MeV}$ and $1\,\text{eV}=1.602\times 10^{-19}\,\text{J}$, $N_A=6.022\times 10^{23}\,\text{mol}^{-1}$.

(a) Calculate $Q$ (MeV) for the reaction.</br>
(b) Estimate the energy released if $1\,\text{mol}$ of such reactions occur.</br>
